summary.text: Joseph Cervantes is a Democrat who has served in the New Mexico Senate since 2013, representing District 31 in Doña Ana and Otero counties.
The legislature's member page lists Cervantes as a representative from 2001 to 2012, and as chair of the Senate Judiciary Committee.

paragraphs.text: The legislature's member page lists Cervantes's occupation as attorney.
Cervantes also sits on the Senate Conservation Committee and the Senate Committees' Committee and, between sessions, is vice chair of the Courts, Corrections and Justice Committee.
